product.name: REPLACE: short product name (e.g. Ice Roller)
product.image_path: REPLACE: full path to product image, e.g. /Users/you/Desktop/products/ice-roller.png
product.what_it_is: REPLACE: one sentence description (e.g. A 12-dollar handheld ice roller for your face)
product.what_it_does: REPLACE: one sentence outcome (e.g. De-puffs your face in 5 minutes)

buyer.archetype: REPLACE: one of [gym-bro-twenties, busy-mom-thirties, gen-z-creator, white-collar-professional, outdoorsy-thirties, senior]
buyer.specifics: REPLACE: any audience details (e.g. women 28-40, post-partum, tired-of-puffy-mornings)

vibe: REPLACE: one of [excited-high-energy, calm-educational, sarcastic-funny, soft-aspirational]

cta.type: REPLACE: one of [link-in-bio, comment-keyword, code-discount, follow-for-more]
cta.details: REPLACE: e.g. ICE for the link, code SAVE20 at checkout

video.platform: REPLACE: tiktok | reels | youtube-shorts (all 9:16, this affects caption + hashtags)

saved_character_id: OPTIONAL: Higgsfield job_id of a previously generated actor (from /character-locker), to reuse the same face
